scope: Final SDK-12 packaging, compatibility closure, standalone Windows x64 Debug/Release runtime deployments, default -editor -> WindowIde launch vs separate control Vulkan host harness, sequential Vulkan GPU workflows with multi-project switching, multi-domain authoring, document/preview reopen, cancellation guards, all engaged renderer paths, archived legacy migration suite audit, budgets, and residual limitations.

archivedLegacySuites.notes: Old C++/CLI editor subdirectories (controls, dialog, model, particle) and migration test harnesses are archived/inactive; only modern C++26 + .NET 11 targets participate in active CMake/CTest builds.

residualLimitations: GI / Light Propagation Volumes (LPV) remain deferred and outside active Vulkan parity.
Terrain/level tool tab "object painter" remains dormant per original level_editor.cpp:432 while source files stay preserved.

SDK-0 original 2011 binary startup crash (pre-existing C++ runtime/resource blocker) remains recorded; acceptance relies on source/document fallback plus verified modernized runtime without claiming fresh 2011-binary UI parity.

Reference projects alex and dima_light_test are verified in isolated Project loading because the prepared pack omits their legacy terrain layer textures and props/box/dogbox model required for full native Vulkan scene cooking.
Active particle scenes in Vulkan restrict viewport view modes to lit and unlit; the full 21-mode Vulkan catalog is verified sequentially on static lit scenes.
Legacy Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel (Office 12 COM) is replaced by dependency-free managed OpenXML (.xlsx) + SpreadsheetML (.xls) + .batch exchange.
Legacy Maya 2011 C++/CLI export plugin is replaced by cross-platform Blender 5.3 extension and Maya Python API 2.0 plugin + standalone C++26 cooker.
Historical MS Word design-doc illustrations (tag/filter clouds, preset curves, sound compressor/EQ mockups) are explicitly excluded from parity claims unless code-backed.
Windows Registry HKCU\Software\GSC Game World\X-Ray SDK storage is replaced by isolated JSON/XML settings under user-data/.
